title: The Star Forest
description: New Biomes, A new Dimension, Structures, Mobs and More!
body:
VERY SMALL ATM

I am working on much more for this project and im excited to see what people think about it!

Feel free to add suggestions im open to them! and thank you for playing my mod!



This mod features a new biome called The Star Forest and The Void (seen in the new dimension)



A new villager type 



Ores and tools



A new structure with a new mob



music disc and more!
